method: Read-only primary-source inspection and independent manual reasoning; parallel literature checker plus reviewer inspection of key primary text.
source_bytes_policy: Original third-party paper bytes were not downloaded into the workspace or redistributed. URLs/version/pages identify the originals. No original PDF/HTML byte SHA is claimed. Evidence notes below are reviewer paraphrases, not verbatim primary-source captures.

checks.title: On the Structure of Armstrong Relations for Functional Dependencies
checks.primary_origin: Ronald Fagin author bibliography directly links the original published paper PDF
checks.anchor: Section 3, Lemma 3.1 and the immediately following constructive proof; printed pages 33-34; PDF pages 4-5 (1-based)
checks.evidence_note: Lemma 3.1 supplies a two-tuple FD nonimplication witness. The following constructive proof agrees on X closure and differs outside it.
checks.scope_limit: Single-relation FD witness; not direct PK/FK combined-query theorem, and not a two-row global Armstrong relation separating all nonimplied FDs simultaneously.
checks.reviewer_inference: Projection into the explicitly closed self-join-free body plus the manuscript's legality/count argument is a mature specialization; novelty NULL is supported.
checks.locator_correction: Prefer this author-linked primary PDF to ResearchGate; keep the distinction between the lemma's first proof and its following constructive proof.
checks.evidence_note_hash_scope: Exact UTF-8 reviewer paraphrase in evidence_note; not the original source bytes.

checks.title: Few Rows Tell Them Apart: Equivalence of Queries Mixing Set and Bag Semantics
checks.anchor: Section 4: Lemma 11 and key-anchorability definition p.9; Theorem 13 pp.9-10; Theorem 15 p.10; residual-open-case p.11; Appendix B.2 Proposition B.3 pp.22-23
checks.evidence_note: Demotion preserves multiplicity by a projection bijection. Key-anchorability requires counted variables to lie in closure of the head and counted variables occurring only at key positions. Theorems 13/15 retain that restriction.
checks.scope_limit: Does not settle the general nonanchorable constrained realizability problem; no claim that the exact Round08 specialization appears verbatim.
checks.F2_reason: x appears at X's key but at C(c,x)'s non-key position. Demoting y on the N side still leaves nonanchored x. These are reviewer deductions, not source examples.
checks.evidence_note_hash_scope: Exact UTF-8 reviewer paraphrase in evidence_note; not the original source bytes.

checks.title: Equivalence of Queries with Nested Aggregation
checks.primary_origin: University of Waterloo institutional dissertation repository
checks.anchor: Appendix A.2; Definitions A.2.1/A.2.2 printed p.168 (PDF page188); multiplicity polynomial discussion printed p.170 (PDF page190); Definitions A.2.3/A.2.4, Theorem A.2.5 and Corollaries A.2.6-A.2.8 printed p.171 (PDF page191), all PDF pages 1-based
checks.evidence_note: Colour diversification uses positive-integer points; multiplicities are represented polynomially; Schwartz-Zippel and subsequent corollaries supply separating diversification points.
checks.scope_limit: No blanket preservation of arbitrary PK/FK constraints by diversification is established by these anchors.
checks.locator_correction: The frozen references.json range p.170-171 does not contain Definitions A.2.1/A.2.2, which are on p.168.
checks.evidence_note_hash_scope: Exact UTF-8 reviewer paraphrase in evidence_note; not the original source bytes.

checks.title: Equivalence of SQL Queries In Presence of Embedded Dependencies
checks.anchor: Section2.1 canonical database and reversed containment homomorphism, PDF p.3; Section6.1 Theorems6.1/6.2, PDF p.13; HTML/PDF numbering differences explicitly recorded below
checks.evidence_note: Set containment uses a head-preserving homomorphism in the reverse direction. Theorems6.1/6.2 reduce constrained bag/bag-set equivalence using their sound chases when set-chase results exist.
checks.scope_limit: The bag reduction retains set-enforcing dependencies. These are not unrestricted ordinary-set-chase or general partial-counting theorems. Round08 must itself prove canonical database legality and self-join-free rigidity.
checks.evidence_note_hash_scope: Exact UTF-8 reviewer paraphrase in evidence_note; not the original source bytes.

novelty_conclusion: NULL mechanism is well supported by direct mature ingredients. This check neither asserts prior verbatim publication of the exact combined specialization nor claims a literature-wide absence proof.
